source.note: Wave-1 row 197 named Quaternius's static 'Bow' on the poly.pizza CDN, which is blocked (Cloudflare challenge). This is Bow_Wooden.fbx from Quaternius's LowPoly Medieval Weapons pack on OpenGameArt (CC0 on the page), very likely the same wooden bow. No free Japanese yumi was found: OpenGameArt 3D search for 'yumi' had nothing; KayKit Adventurers (672074b) and Skeletons (15b62b9) ship only crossbows, arrows and quivers. Candidates rendered and rejected: Bow_Wooden2 (same pack, stiffer stepped limbs), Quaternius RPG Characters Ranger_Bow (spiky fantasy bow with a big hand guard) and tbbk's Low Poly Composite Bow (CC0, clean recurve but 1 cm deep, so it turns into a hairline in cel). Orientation: standing upright on its lower tip, string vertical; the arrow direction is +Z (back of the bow towards +Z, string at -Z), so the left view shows it broadside with the back to image-left and the front view shows it edge-on. Grip: the red-wrapped section at mid-height, about 0.6-0.8 m up (centre ~0.7 m), on the bow's centre line; the string runs between the nocks just inside the two tips.Shipped at 1.4 m tip to tip, a short recurve-style hunting bow (real bows 1.2-2 m); the limbs are chunky and stylized, so it reads as a game/fantasy bow, not a slender longbow or yumi. Static, no clips. Colours (indigo): wood in iris over sky with threshold 0.1 so only the undersides shade, the leather grip in accent, the string in moon.
